termination_notice_period.value: One (1) year's written notice of termination if either Party ceases substantially all activities in the COLLABORATION CROPS; thirty (30) days' written notice to CERES for the bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership or dissolution events; thirty (30) days' written notice to IGER if John Clifton-Brown or Iain Donnison cease to be associated with IGER; ninety (90) days' written notice if the institutional mission, purpose, structure or funding of IGER would change substantially; one (1) years' written notice if CERES has a documented compelling business reason to cease the collaboration; three (3) months' prior written notice if no rights to commercialize the COLLABORATION CROPS germplasm have been secured; thirty (30) days' written notice if Defra has not assigned or granted an exclusive license; and material-breach termination after a thirty (30) day payment or ninety (90) day other cure period.
evidence: (c) one (1) year's written notice of termination by either CERES or IGER to the other Party in case either the terminating Party or the other Party ceases substantially all activities in the COLLABORATION CROPS;

(d) IGER will have the right to terminate this Agreement unilaterally with thirty (30) days' written notice to CERES, (i) if CERES seeks protection under any bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership, trust, deed, creditors arrangement or comparable proceeding
in case of dissolution or winding up of CERES
(e) CERES will have the right to terminate this Agreement unilaterally: (i) with thirty (30) days' written notice to IGER if John Clifton-Brown or Iain Donnison cease(s) to be associated with IGER
(ii) with ninety (90) days' written notice to IGER, if the institutional mission, purpose, structure or funding of IGER would change substantially
(iii) with one (1) years' written notice to IGER, if CERES has a documented compelling business reason to cease the collaboration
(iv)  with three (3) months' prior written notice to IGER, such notice to be given no earlier than eighteen (18)
months after the Effective Date, if no rights to commercialize
have been secured to CERES' reasonable satisfaction in compliance with the CBD

(v) with thirty (30) days' written notice to IGER if Defra has not assigned to IGER, or granted to IGER an exclusive license reasonably satisfactory to CERES on, the Intellectual Property vested in Defra

(b) failure of one Party to satisfy its material obligations under this Agreement, and such Party subsequently fails to cure such failure(s) within (i) thirty (30) days for failures to remit payment for amounts due under this Agreement and (ii) ninety (90) days for all other obligations
The seat of arbitration shall be Paris, France.

payment_terms.value: Quarterly invoices after the end of each calendar quarter for research work performed, payable by CERES within thirty (30) days after the invoice date, remitted to the Institute Secretary at Plas Gogerddan; royalties on NET SALES and LICENSE INCOME are payable in United States dollars by March 31 of each year with a written report, net of withholding tax, and overdue payments bear interest at one percent (1%) above the prime interest rate.
evidence: 1.8 Where a SCHEDULE provides that CERES will make a financial contribution to certain RESEARCH PROJECT activities performed by IGER,  unless agreed otherwise in the appropriate SCHEDULE, IGER will submit invoices after the end of each calendar quarter for the work performed  during that quarter.
CERES will pay all such invoices within thirty  (30) days after the invoice date. Payments shall be remitted to:
Institute Secretary   Institute of Grassland and Environmental Research   Plas Gogerddan

4.5 All sums payable by CERES to IGER under this Agreement shall be payable in United States dollars. Royalties shall be payable by March 31 of  each year with respect to the NET SALES and LICENSE INCOME received by CERES and any AFFILIATED COMPANIES in the preceding  calendar year.
Such payments shall be accompanied by a written report setting forth the production volumes and sales
4.4 Where any royalty payments are subject to a withholding tax, CERES shall pay the net royalty
4.6 Payments required under this Agreement shall, if overdue, bear interest at a per annum rate of one percent (1%) above the prime interest rate in  effect on the due date

territory.value: All countries of the world except the United Kingdom
evidence: 1.4 "TERRITORY" shall mean all countries of the world except the United Kingdom.

alternatives.expiration_date: Article 14.1 sets a fifteen-year term from the Effective Date (which would end 2022-04-01 only by arithmetic); no calendar end date is stated, so no date is labelled.
alternatives.territory: Article 5.3.2 grants an exclusive, world-wide licence subject to Article 5.2 (IGER's United Kingdom commercialization rights); Exhibit G defines TERRITORY as all countries of the world except the United Kingdom. The explicit definition is labelled.
alternatives.party_roles: Amendment II substitutes Aberystwyth University for IGER as a contract party; the label lists the parties named in the agreement's preamble and execution block.
alternatives.signatories: Amendments II and III are signed for Aberystwyth University by S.G.A. Durbin, Emyr Reynolds and Jefferson Gwyn; they sign the amending instruments, not the Collaboration Agreement's execution block, so they are not listed.
alternatives.termination_notice_period: Schedule 1 Article 16 requires the Parties to decide whether to extend at least one year before the end of the Schedule term; that is an extension-decision deadline, not a notice to terminate or avoid renewal. Exhibit G Article 16.4 lets CERES terminate by written notice with no period stated.
